hero.description: Modes, zone rules, door/window contacts, schedules, sunrise/sunset, lux and automatic mode.

submodes.title: Sub modes
submodes.description: Create extra choices under a main mode, for example Watch TV under Home.

zones.title: Zone rules
zones.description: Motion, door/window contacts, subzones, lights, dimming and conditions.

light_settings.title: Light settings
light_settings.description: Set what should happen per light when motion or contact becomes active.

sensor_inactive.title: When sensor is inactive
sensor_inactive.description: These light settings are applied when there is no motion after the configured time or when a selected door/window contact becomes inactive again. Leave this list empty to switch the selected lights off as before.

behavior.motion_active: Apply light settings when motion is detected
behavior.motion_inactive: Apply inactive light settings after no motion
behavior.contact_active: Apply light settings when contact is active
behavior.contact_inactive: Apply inactive light settings when contact is inactive
behavior.only_if_lights_off: Only run if selected lights are off

temperature.title: Temperature per mode and zone
temperature.description: Set the desired temperature per mode and zone. Devices with target_temperature are updated automatically when the mode changes and immediately when a selected window/door contact opens or closes.

appliances.title: Appliance notifications
appliances.description: Detect start and ready status using power consumption from a smart plug or device with measure_power.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Switch lights/devices on or off at a fixed time, random time, sunrise or sunset. Optionally use lux per zone.

import_export.title: Import / export
import_export.description: Create a backup of everything or choose which sections to include.

export.title: Export
export.description: Choose sections and copy a JSON backup.

import.title: Import
import.description: Choose a previously created JSON backup. You can then select which sections to restore.
import.placeholder: Paste the JSON export here if choosing a file does not work

activities.title: Activity monitoring
activities.description: Detect activities using multiple conditions such as water, gas, power, device status or sensors.
activities.hint: Open an activity to change its name, conditions, thresholds and history settings.

debug.description: The latest app errors. These remain available after an automatic restart.
debug.title: Crash log

display.description: Choose which temperature device is shown in the top-right of Current mode and whether the Mode widget shows live context.
display.live_context_hint: Automatically gives the main mode buttons a day/night background with sun, moon, clouds, rain, snow, fog or thunder. Uses the selected temperature/weather device where possible.
display.temperature_device_hint: Choose a device with temperature measurement. Empty = hide badge.
display.title: Current mode display

keypads.description: Link a PIN directly to a mode. The PIN is not stored in readable form after saving.
keypads.title: Keypads

main_modes.description: Only change the visible names. The internal IDs remain home, sleep, away and vacation so existing flows and rules keep working.
main_modes.title: Main modes

mode_switch_devices.description: Link actions to the list modes and on/off switches of created Mode & Switch devices.
mode_switch_devices.hint: Configure devices or lights to switch on or off per device and mode, just like with the original controller.
mode_switch_devices.title: Mode & Switch devices

modes_ui.intro_title: Modes are the foundation of your home
modes_ui.intro_description: A main mode describes the overall situation, such as Home, Sleep, Away or Vacation. A sub mode adds a more specific situation within it, such as Evening or Watching TV under Home.
modes_ui.help_text: The four main modes always remain available so existing Flows and rules keep working. You can rename them. Modes you add yourself are always sub modes and belong to one main mode.
modes_ui.choose_mode_hint: Select a main mode or sub mode on the left to view its settings.
modes_ui.main_mode_fixed_hint: This main mode is part of the fixed foundation of Mode Switch.
modes_ui.visible_name_hint: You can change the name. The internal ID stays unchanged so existing Flows and rules keep working.
modes_ui.submodes_in_main: Sub modes in this main mode
modes_ui.internal_id_hint: The internal ID is shown for reference only and cannot be changed.
modes_ui.general_settings_hint: Name, automatic activation and appearance of this sub mode.
modes_ui.what_happens_hint: Start with the overview. Open only the part you want to change.
modes_ui.devices_desc: Switch devices on or off when this mode activates.
modes_ui.lighting_desc: On/off, dimming, color and white balance.
modes_ui.no_temperature: No temperature rules for this mode
modes_ui.delayed_desc: Actions that run after a configured delay.
modes_ui.editor_hint: Change only this section here. Changes are included when you use Save all.
modes_ui.no_temperature_rule_toast: No temperature rule for this mode yet. You can add one directly.
modes_ui.no_submodes_in_main: No sub modes under this main mode yet.
modes_ui.wizard_description: Create a new sub mode in three short steps.
modes_ui.step1_text: A sub mode always belongs to one main mode. Choose where this new situation belongs.
modes_ui.step1_example: Example: Evening and Watching TV usually belong under Home.
modes_ui.change_later: You can always change this later.
modes_ui.step2_text: Choose a short name that describes what is different at that moment.
modes_ui.examples_hint: Tap an example to use it as the name.
modes_ui.icon_hint: This makes the sub mode easier to recognize in the overview and widget.
modes_ui.after_create: After creating it, we open the sub mode directly. There you can configure automatic activation and appearance.
modes_ui.no_advanced_needed: You do not need to choose advanced settings yet.

avd_integration.title: Advanced Virtual Device (AVD)
avd_integration.desc: Import existing AVD devices and link actions to lists, buttons and Yes/No fields.
avd_integration.none: No usable AVD devices found. Install Device Capabilities and create an Advanced Virtual Device first.
avd_integration.enabled: Actions for this AVD device enabled
avd_integration.empty: This AVD has no supported lists, buttons or booleans yet.
avd_integration.hint: Mode Switch listens only to imported capabilities. No extra polling is used for this integration.
avd_integration.toggles_hint: Link devices to an AVD On/Off switch. Linked devices follow the switch automatically.
avd_integration.linked_hint: AVD ON turns these devices on; AVD OFF turns the same devices off.
avd_integration.advanced_hint: Optional: add extra devices that should behave differently for ON or OFF.
avd_integration.exclusive_group_hint: Give multiple AVD buttons or On/Off fields the same group name. When one becomes ON/active, Mode Switch silently switches the other group members OFF without running their linked actions.
avd_integration.buttons_group_hint: Use an exclusive group when only one AVD button may be active at a time. Internal OFF synchronization does not start new Mode Switch actions.
avd_integration.group_actions_hint: Configure what Mode Switch should do when every stateful control in an exclusive group is OFF. Internal synchronization does not cause a false all-off action.
avd_integration.group_all_off_hint: Runs once when the group changes from at least one active control to no active controls. Example: switch three devices off.
avd_integration.button_on_hint: These actions run only for a real ON event from the AVD button.
avd_integration.button_off_hint: These actions run only when the AVD button really turns OFF. If Mode Switch switches it OFF itself because of an exclusive group, these actions are intentionally skipped.

catalog.no_completed_cycles_have_been_saved_yet: No completed cycles have been saved yet.
catalog.create_activities_from_the_settings_page: Create activities from the settings page.
catalog.settings_this_widget_only_uses_existing_: This widget only uses existing configuration: sub modes, mode rules, zone rules, temperature rules, appliance notifications, schedules and automatic mode.
catalog.settings_mode_rules_are_shown_compactly_: Mode rules are shown compactly here. Detailed rules remain in the normal settings page.
catalog.settings_zone_rules_contain_existing_set: Zone rules contain existing settings such as motion, door/window contacts, lights, lux and times.
catalog.settings_uses_existing_temperature_rules: Uses existing temperature rules per mode/zone, including window and smart weather settings where available.
catalog.settings_uses_existing_monitoring_rules_: Uses existing monitoring rules based on power consumption.
catalog.settings_schedule_uses_existing_options_: Schedule uses existing options: fixed time, random time, sunrise/sunset, auto on/off and lux conditions.
catalog.settings_only_existing_automatic_mode_fi: Only existing automatic-mode fields are saved; unknown fields remain unchanged.
catalog.settings_import_intentionally_remains_on: Import intentionally remains on the normal settings page so you keep the preview/check step.
